What do the Sikhs of Patna Sahib think about the upcoming Bihar elections?
In this ground report from Patna, people share their views on Modi, Nitish Kumar and Tejashwi Yadav and talk about who they want to see in power.
Watch this report to know what the Sikh community in Patna is saying about politics, development and the future of Bihar.
